notes: This only watches and writes down what the controller's receiver sends when you press each paddle and SAX key, alone and in pairs, so we learn what extra button the controller adds next to each one. Nothing passes or fails: every step ends with "Recorded". Before you start: the controller on and awake, Mapping off, the Parallels VM not running, Shadow not forwarding the receiver, and look at the light colour on the controller and remember it. Run it on the App path. Do not press Profile except where a step says so. For each step: let go of everything and wait for Go, then do what the step says at an easy pace (about one press a second, letting go completely each time); the step ends by itself a moment after you are done. "Hold X, press Y" means keep X held down while you press Y, and let go of X last. The last three blocks press Profile once while a paddle is held: after each one, look at the light colour and write it down. After the last block, press Profile until your starting colour is back. Afterwards the run file in the dev-runs folder is read with scripts/tools/echo-survey.py.
